firstRun.title: Welcome to PokeHub
firstRun.intro: Choose the folder where the hub will keep the tools, runtimes and your projects. Everything lives inside it, organized like this:
firstRun.tree:
tools/      tools (DSPRE, melonDS, ...)
runtimes/   Java, portable Git, MSYS2
projects/   your hacks, each with base.nds, workspace/ and builds/
cache/      reused downloads
firstRun.hint: Suggestion: an empty folder on a drive with free space, e.g. D:\PokeHub. You can change it later by deleting %AppData%\PokeHub\settings.json.

feature.tables.text: Moves, items, learnsets, evolutions, babies, trades, TMs, marts, tutors and script values in one editor.
tables.title: Game tables
tables.moves.note: Power, type, accuracy, PP and other data of each move. Effect is the battle effect number.
tables.items.note: Price, battle and bag data. What using the item does cannot be changed here.
tables.learnsets.note: Moves by level. Saving sorts the list by level, as the game requires, with up to 21 moves.
tables.evolutions.note: Parameter is the required level, item, move or Pokémon, depending on the method. Up to seven evolutions.
tables.eggMoves.note: The whole list cannot exceed its original size: to add moves, remove some from another species. On Platinum, ds-rom projects only.
tables.babies.note: The species that hatches from each Pokémon's egg.
tables.heightWeight.note: What the Pokédex shows: height in decimeters and weight in hectograms (Pikachu: 4 and 60).
tables.trades.note: What the NPC gives and asks for. The nickname and trainer name are in the texts.
tables.tmCompat.note: Which TMs and HMs each species learns.
tables.tmMoves.note: The move taught by each TM. HMs are left out: the hub uses them to find the table.
tables.marts.note: Items of special marts. You can swap items, not make the list longer. The mart number is the one scripts use.
tables.tutors.note: Move taught and cost of each tutor: BP on HG/SS, shards on Platinum.
tables.col.name: Name
core.tables.noDp: Tables cover HeartGold, SoulSilver and Platinum; Diamond and Pearl not yet.
core.tables.tooMany: The game accepts up to {0} level-up moves per species.
core.tables.eggFull: The egg move list is {0} entries over the game's size: remove moves from another species.
tables.scripts.note: Command values of each file: message, flag, variable, species, item, trainer. To add commands or change jumps, use DSPRE.
tables.typeChart.note: Only pairs that differ from normal: 20 is double, 5 is half and 0 is no effect. You can swap pairs, not add new ones.
tables.frontierMons.note: Sets used by Frontier trainers. Effort flags: one bit per stat.
feature.scripts.text: Reads each map's commands and lets you insert and remove them, with jumps recalculated.
scr.title: Script editor
scr.hint: Whatever jumped to the selected command now runs the new one first. For jumps, type the target position as shown in the list.
tables.frontierTrainers.note: The class and the set numbers each one can use, from the Battle Frontier Pokémon table.
tables.headbutt.note: Slots of each map with trees. Tree positions do not change here.
tables.safari.note: Encounters of each area. Bonuses per placed object do not change here.
tables.martBadges.note: What every mart sells and how many badges each item requires.
tables.spritePosition.note: Vertical adjustment of the battle sprite and the shadow of each species. Animations do not change here.
tables.pokeathlon.note: Base level of each stat per species and the limits of the daily variation. The events themselves do not change here.
tables.contestOpponents.note: Species and moves of the opponents. Their other data, such as condition and accessories, has no confirmed meaning and stays as is.

feature.inject.text: New C or assembly code in the game, without leaving the workspace: change mechanics and keep using the editors.
inject.title: Code injection
inject.intro: Each patch is a folder with patch.json and C or assembly sources in workspace/code-patches. Tick the ones that should go into the game and click Build and apply. A version is saved before and after.
inject.name: Patch
inject.done: Done: {0} patch(es) applied, {1} bytes free. Use Test to see it in the game.
inject.reverted: Done: no patches in the game. The ARM9 expansion stays in the ROM.
inject.confirmRevert: Take all code patches out of the game? The patch folders stay in the project.
core.inject.misaligned: Address {0} is misaligned: this hook type needs a multiple of {1}. Check the address and the mode field.
core.inject.outOfRange: The call from {0} to {1} is too far for BL. Use the jump type.
core.inject.expansionConflict: The ARM9 is not as expected at {0} or {1}. Another tool (hg-engine, for example) already changed those points, or the game is another version. Nothing was written.
core.inject.compileFailed: Patch {0}: {1} ended with error {2}. The compiler message is in the log; nothing was written.
core.inject.noOverlay: Overlay {0} does not exist in this game.
core.inject.needDsRom: Code injection needs the workspace in ds-rom format. This project uses the ndstool format: save a version and extract the ROM again.
core.inject.templateDescription: Describe here what this patch changes.
core.inject.gameUnsupported: Code injection is not supported for this game yet ({0}).
core.inject.wrongGame: Patch {0} is for {1}, and this project is {2}. Addresses change between game versions.
core.inject.noToolchain: ARM compiler not found. Install MSYS2 under Tools, in the Decomp and toolchain group.
core.inject.tooBig: The patches do not fit: {0} went past the {1} bytes available. Nothing was written.
core.inject.expansionApplied: ARM9 expansion applied (the same as DSPRE's).
core.inject.overlap: The hook at {0} of patch {1} overlaps a range already used by {2}. Nothing was written.
core.inject.expectFailed: Patch {0}: {1} holds {2}, but the patch expects {3}. The address is from another version or the range was already changed. Nothing was written.
core.inject.noExpect: Warning: the hook at {1} of patch {0} has no "expect", so a wrong address goes undetected.
core.inject.noSymbol: Patch {0}: symbol {1} is neither in the code nor in "symbols". Nothing was written.
core.inject.ledgerMismatch: The bytes of patch {0} in {1} ({2}) changed outside the hub. Removing or reapplying now would break that edit. Go back a version or undo the change. Nothing was written.
core.inject.syntheticMissing: ARM9 expansion file not found in the workspace.
core.inject.regionUsed: Patch {0}: the expansion area is already in use at {1}, probably by a DSPRE patch. Nothing was written.
